summary: Semantic search over your own documents with pgvector in the Postgres you already run: chunked documents with embeddings, cosine search with an HNSW index, hybrid ranking with full-text so exact identifiers still win, a localhost search page, and backups that are just pg_dump.

stack.why: rule zero: a vector index is a column type
OpenAI or a local model via Ollama; swappable by env

prerequisites.name: Node.js 22 or newer
prerequisites.why: Everything in this build runs on it: the server, the scripts, the tests.
prerequisites.get: Download the LTS installer from nodejs.org, or install with your package manager (brew install node, or nvm install 22). Restart the terminal afterwards.

prerequisites.name: A terminal and a code editor
prerequisites.why: Every step below is a command you type or a file you edit.
prerequisites.get: VS Code (code.visualstudio.com), Cursor or Zed. Open a folder for the project and use the editor's built-in terminal.
prerequisites.verify: You can open a folder and run a command in its terminal

prerequisites.name: Git
prerequisites.why: History for your code, and the way most hosts deploy.
prerequisites.get: Install from git-scm.com or with your package manager, then run git init in the project folder once it exists.

prerequisites.name: Postgres 16 with the pgvector extension
prerequisites.get: Docker: docker run -d -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=pw -p 5432:5432 pgvector/pgvector:pg16. Or install pgvector on an existing Postgres.

prerequisites.name: An embeddings API key, or Ollama locally
prerequisites.get: OpenAI: platform.openai.com/api-keys. Local: install Ollama and ollama pull nomic-embed-text.
prerequisites.cost: pay per use, or free locally

prerequisites.name: The documents to search
prerequisites.why: Markdown, PDFs converted to text, or a folder of notes.

env.name: EMBED_MODEL
env.where: Model name; dimension must match the column.

phases.title: Store and embed
phases.goal: Chunks with vectors, idempotent on document hash, provider swappable.

steps.detail: documents (id, source, title, url, updated_at, hash), chunks (id, document_id, position, text, embedding vector(N), token_count). N matches EMBED_MODEL's dimension.
commands: mkdir semantic && cd semantic && git init && npm init -y && npm pkg set type=module && npm install pg@8

steps.do: Chunk by paragraph around 500 tokens with overlap; embed behind an interface; skip unchanged documents by hash

check: Re-ingesting an unchanged document embeds nothing
A changed one re-embeds only its chunks

phases.title: Search
phases.goal: Top-k by cosine with an HNSW index actually used.

steps.do: Create the HNSW index and the query function
commands: CREATE INDEX ON chunks USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops);

steps.do: Verify the plan uses the index
commands: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT ... ORDER BY embedding <=> $1 LIMIT 10;

check: A known passage returns in the top 3

phases.title: Hybrid
phases.goal: Exact identifiers win: fuse vector and full-text ranks.

steps.do: Add a tsvector column and GIN index
Reciprocal rank fusion of both result lists

check: A query with an exact error code ranks the matching chunk first

phases.title: A page
phases.goal: Localhost search with highlighted passages and source links.

steps.do: A JSON endpoint and a server-rendered page
pg_dump nightly and one restore; README with the chunking rule and provider swap

phases.title: Serve it to others
phases.goal: Auth, rate limits, and cost visibility.

steps.do: Token auth and a rate limit on the JSON endpoint
Log embedding calls and estimate monthly cost

product.outcome: Semantic search as a column in your database, with exact-match behaviour preserved and backups you already know how to do.

architecture.swap: Qdrant at scale, same chunk shape

notIncluded: Billions of vectors and serverless scale; under a few million this is a column.
